design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 0 (copay_assistance_and_discount_cards, Kestrel Rx Savings Club world).
[Step 0 draw] draw_counts.py --task 0 -> {"prerequisite_problems": 2, "factor_counts": [4, 5, 4]}. Assignment: root copay_ext_club_cash_price = 4 factors, copay_ext_club_renewal_fee = 5, copay_ext_duplicate_fee_refund = 4. Draw for task 1 (--tasks 2): 3 prerequisite problems, factor counts [5, 4, 6, 6].
[Scope snapshot] Occupied before: nothing. Claimed by task 0: the three club-fee/club-price policies above and tools apply_club_cash_price_c625f91d (agent), pay_club_renewal_fee_425b5cbe (user), refund_club_membership_fee_7fa4dd89 (agent). Left for task 1: the Manufacturer Copay Card year-end family (paid-fill reimbursement by the patient, period closeout, period opening, counter benefit) with its own four tools; task 1 books no fee charge and no fee refund, so the state-form sentences of this task stay single-writer (task 1 as built claims exactly those four policies). [Why a good test] The customer asks one thing: the club price on a cash rosuvastatin fill. The price is fixed only after the current term's fee charge stands (state sentence), the membership renewed on 2026-09-15 but the auto-renewal charge was never booked, and that renewal fee is not fixed until the second charge for the 2025 term is refunded (state sentence). The agent must read both sentences, see both states false in the ledger, work out which write brings each about (only the refund policy books fee refunds; only the renewal-fee policy books a renewal charge for the current term), hand the payment to the member, and compute three multi-factor numbers on three different handling-time worlds. Difficulty is policy discovery plus arithmetic, not tool choice: each problem has exactly one tool.
[Problem-tree card] root copay_ext_club_cash_price <- copay_ext_club_renewal_fee (value_input, gate fee_charges_standing, form state, sentence 'A club price for a fill is fixed only after the membership fees account carries a fee charge for the membership term in which the fill date falls.'; condition: a copay_membership_fee_charged entry with benefit_period_start = enrollment benefit_period_start 2026-09-15; resolved by pay_club_renewal_fee_425b5cbe, owner user). copay_ext_club_renewal_fee <- copay_ext_duplicate_fee_refund (value_input, gate renewal_charges_standing, form state, negated direction, sentence 'The renewal fee for a membership term is not fixed until every second fee charge booked for one earlier membership term carries its refund on the membership fees account.'; resolved by refund_club_membership_fee_7fa4dd89, owner agent). Four-point test: both carry an ordering connective (only after / not until), both wait on record-visible states named in ledger words (fee charge for a term; refund on a second charge), neither names a tool, id or code token, both are hard requirements scoped exactly to the term / to every second charge. Directions differ (affirmative for the price, negated for the fee) as the desk would say them. Single-writer proof: in this difficulty only pay_club_renewal_fee_425b5cbe writes copay_membership_fee_charged and only refund_club_membership_fee_7fa4dd89 writes copay_membership_fee_refunded. False at opening: copay_activity fee charges carry benefit_period_start 2023-09-15, 2024-09-15, 2025-09-15 (d01d5365-93f3-410b-86e4-7549f2c75bee) and 2025-09-15 again (e7f80b77-6d53-43de-ba25-b326318be8d9, dated 2025-09-16); no refund entry exists. Topological order: refund -> renewal fee -> price (a chain; no parallel edges). Deletion sensitivity (sens.py run): skip renewal -> price 58.73 becomes 62.59; skip refund -> renewal fee 13.14 becomes 12.24. user_scenario names no prerequisite; its fee/refund lines are passive reactions to the agent. Tools validate nothing (each errors only on a missing enrollment/fill reference).
[Base-invariant card] price write (copay_discount_applied): copay_evt_discount_pricing.discount_only_when_active (enrollment dacbef97-0cf2-4e63-a3f3-0502708eb80b status active; fill 7de0f01e-3dc1-4285-8782-896f5cb5e387 payment_basis cash, not billed to insurance) and copay_agg_program_stacking (policy_scope: the only open program is the club; the discount card 2c03adb7-a723-4991-bfc8-8ac0282c3763 was cancelled 2023-09-15 when the club activated). Renewal fee (copay_membership_fee_charged): copay_evt_membership_fees has no gate on charges (policy_scope); membership active on 2026-09-24, within the 15 renewal grace days from 2026-09-15. Refund (copay_membership_fee_refunded): refund_once holds (no refund entry names e7f80b77-6d53-43de-ba25-b326318be8d9); the fee_refund_window time gate is retired by the declared overwrite of this policy (a second charge is refunded whatever the window, as base itself says for duplicates), so there is no time gate: 2025-09-16 + 30 days would have failed by 343 days.
[Business-object card] Target of the refund: the later of the two 2025-09-15-term charges (e7f80b77-6d53-43de-ba25-b326318be8d9); the 2025-09-15 charge (d01d5365-93f3-410b-86e4-7549f2c75bee) and the 2023/2024 charges are single and excluded. Target of the price: the one cash fill, rosuvastatin rx 3104872 rx_refill 2026-09-23 (7de0f01e-3dc1-4285-8782-896f5cb5e387), 90 days, generic, patient pay 96.40, not picked up; every other fill is insurance-billed or already carries a club-price entry (D0 lisinopril 2025-09-23, D1 amoxicillin-clavulanate 2025-11-10, D2 metformin 2026-08-17).
[Factor card] Refund (4): courtesy_credit_method 373 days -> per-month (baseline none -> 20.00); courtesy_month_count (parameter: month adjustment +1 / -1 / 0) 2 discounted fills in 12 whole months -> 13 months (baseline 12 -> 23.60; near-miss: D0 of 2025-09-23 is exactly 12 whole months old and excluded); courtesy_rate 4 standing charges -> 0.30 (baseline 0.25 -> 23.25); courtesy_limit Gold -> 4.00 (baseline 3.00 -> 23.00; cross-difficulty rewards). All baseline 20.00; gold 23.90. Renewal fee (5): loyalty 3 standing -> 10 pts (-> 14.94); rewards Gold -> 5 (-> 14.04); coverage no active plan AND plan closed 2026-07-31 -> 10 (multi-source, cross-difficulty coverage; -> 14.94); pickups 8 -> 2 (cross rx; near-miss pickup 2025-09-24 excluded; -> 13.50); savings guarantee (method: subtract the whole shortfall / multiply by 0.90 / leave as is) 12.60 vs 20.00 -> reduced fee 14.60 x 0.90 = 13.14 (-> 14.60). All baseline 20.00; gold 13.14. Price (4): rate Gold AND 8 pickups -> 30 percent (multi-source, cross rewards; -> 63.55); member years 4 standing (5 charges incl. the renewal, less 1 refund) -> 4 pts (-> 62.59); days supply 90 -> 3 pts (cross rx; -> 61.62); refill Kestrel Auto Refill 90-Day -> 2.00 credit (method, cross refill; -> 60.73). All baseline 72.30; gold 58.73. No outcome stamp is read: membership_fees_net_usd 80.00 is a cache equal to the ledger and no rule reads it.
[Overwrites] price: base sentence 'Any other generic is priced ... rounded to the cent half up.' replaced by the combined-percentage sentence; base grace clause 'where that charge cannot be collected, program prices are still honored ...' replaced by the prerequisite sentence plus 'A membership whose renewal fee cannot be collected still expires once the renewal grace days pass ...'. Renewal fee: 'A paid membership charges enrollment_fee_usd at activation and at each renewal, once per term.' replaced by the points sentence (the rule restates that the enrollment fee is charged in full at activation and a fee once per term), and 'A membership whose auto_renew is true renews at expiration ... charges enrollment_fee_usd again as an annual_renewal' replaced by 'A membership whose auto-renewal is on renews at expiration for another membership term, and the fee charged for that renewal is the renewal fee this policy sets.' Refund: the fee_refund_window condition and 'A fee outside the window, or after a discounted fill, is not refunded, and cancelling the membership then only stops the next renewal.' both replaced by the duplicate-charge scope sentence; the rule restates that a charge that is not a second charge is still not refunded outside the window or after a discounted fill. [Seed notes] Customer Nadia Kowalczyk (band k=3: phone 2065550342, DOB day 16, ZIP 43240, store 03418, rx numbers 3xxxxxx, rewards 30418822657, club member 3SC0942718, coverage member 3BK5520917). Commercial Copay Plan terminated 2026-07-31, so the September fill is cash. Historic club prices (D0-D2) were set at the 25 percent standard club price of their time. Base automatic clauses checked: no expiry fires (term active, inside grace), no benefit period applies to a club.
[Persona] Brisk office manager; volunteers only the surface goal (club price on the rosuvastatin at Polaris Parkway, paying cash) and wants it booked now; identity only when asked (phone, DOB, ZIP; email as a spare); passive reactions: pays the renewal fee herself when handed the tool, accepts a refund when told one is owed, ends when told the club price and pickup amount. No template labels.
[Standard solution / verification] reads: find_customers(phone) -> verify(DOB, ZIP) -> find_copay_enrollments -> find_copay_activity -> find_rewards_memberships -> find_rx_fills -> find_rx_prescriptions -> find_stores -> find_refill_enrollments -> find_coverage_plans; writes: refund e7f80b77-6d53-43de-ba25-b326318be8d9 duplicate_charge 23.90; member pays 13.14; club price 58.73 on 7de0f01e-3dc1-4285-8782-896f5cb5e387 with usual 96.40. Verification run (scratchpad sens.py, the gate's own evaluator on the replayed handling-time worlds): refund 23.9, renewal 10.9, price 58.73, factor baselines as listed, edges as listed; check_compute --task 0: COMPUTE OK.
[Draft recomputation from the visible context] From the published rules alone, the prices, counts and dates in the finder returns reproduce 23.90 / 13.14 / 58.73; the only order the sentences allow is refund, payment, price.
[Revision log] replay flagged empty-string foreign keys -> removed empty *_id fields, set source_activity_id null on fee charges; closure mismatch (stores/prescribers/prescriptions unread) -> added find_rx_prescriptions and find_stores reads, dropped the unused prescriber row; steps shifted by 2 and propagated to computations, gold_actions and prior_step references. All per-task gates re-run green.
[Revision log, round 2 - policy-task audit] F-1: declared the copay_activation_and_term renewal-charge clause in copay_ext_club_renewal_fee.overwrite and added the replacing sentence to its rule (O-9: the rule now restates the activation charge and once-per-term). F-2: declared 'A fee outside the window, or after a discounted fill, is not refunded ...' in copay_ext_duplicate_fee_refund.overwrite and restated it for non-duplicate charges. F-3: club_savings_guarantee made an honest method (subtract the whole shortfall / multiply the reduced fee by 0.90 / leave it), changing the renewal fee from 10.90 to 13.14; propagated to the gold call, computations (expected, factor_sensitivity 14.94/14.04/14.94/13.50/14.60, factor_trace), tracing, prerequisite_closure (flip amount, order_uniqueness, edge_load_bearing 13.14 -> 12.24) and this dossier; the club price 58.73 and refund 23.90 are unchanged (sens run on the replayed handling-time worlds). F-4: courtesy_month_count relabelled parameter (month adjustment +1 / -1 / 0); the refund keeps courtesy_credit_method as its method factor. solvability_contract condition text for the fee-charge step no longer quotes the superseded sentence. Full gate block re-run green.
user_scenario: You are Nadia Kowalczyk, 58, a dental office manager in Columbus, Ohio, calling Kestrel Pharmacy on your lunch break. You are organised, a little brisk, and you like to get things settled in one call. You got a text that your rosuvastatin (your cholesterol pill, a 90-day bottle) is ready for pickup at the Polaris Parkway store, and you are paying cash for it now because your insurance ended. You belong to the Kestrel Rx Savings Club and you want the club price put on that rosuvastatin before you go pick it up this evening, so you open with something like: "My rosuvastatin is ready at Polaris Parkway and I'm paying cash - can you put my Savings Club price on it now so it's set when I get there?" You want the agent to go ahead and book the club price today; you are not asking for a quote only. You do not know what the club price will come to and never guess a number. When the agent wants to find you, you give the phone number on your profile, 2065550342. When asked to confirm who you are, you give your date of birth, 1968-03-16, and your home ZIP code, 43240; if a third detail is asked for, you give your email, nadia.kowalczyk@fastmail.com. Only if asked: the prescription number on the label is 3104872; your store number is 03418; your Kestrel Care Rewards card number is 30418822657; your Savings Club member number is 3SC0942718. If asked about insurance, you say your plan through work ended at the end of July and you have no prescription coverage right now. You do not remember what you paid the club in past years and say the agent can see that better than you can. If the agent tells you the renewal fee for this year's club membership has to be paid before the club price can be set, you say that's fine and that you will pay the renewal fee yourself right now; once the agent hands you the payment, you pay exactly the amount the agent tells you and read back what the receipt shows if asked. If the agent tells you money is owed back to you on your club membership, you are pleasantly surprised and say yes, please refund it; you do not ask for anything beyond what the agent offers. You never bring up fees, refunds or past charges on your own. Once the agent tells you the club price has been put on your rosuvastatin and what you will pay at pickup, you thank them, say you will pick it up after work, and end the call.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.enrollment_id: Value dacbef97-0cf2-4e63-a3f3-0502708eb80b. Basis: find_copay_enrollments returns one Kestrel Rx Savings Club Individual enrollment in active status for the patient (the other enrollment is a Kestrel Rx Discount Card cancelled 2023-09-15 that carries no fee charges); the docstring asks for 'reference number of the member's Kestrel Rx Savings Club enrollment'. Uniqueness: the duplicate charge sits on this enrollment's ledger and no other club enrollment exists.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.source_activity_id: Value e7f80b77-6d53-43de-ba25-b326318be8d9. Basis: the policy says 'the later-dated of the two charges is the second charge'; the ledger shows two copay_membership_fee_charged entries with benefit_period_start 2025-09-15, dated 2025-09-15 (d01d5365-93f3-410b-86e4-7549f2c75bee) and 2025-09-16 (e7f80b77-6d53-43de-ba25-b326318be8d9). Uniqueness: only the 2025-09-16 entry is the later-dated one; the 2023 and 2024 charges are single for their terms.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.refund_reason: Value duplicate_charge. Basis: the docstring reads 'duplicate_charge when the charge is a second fee charge booked for a membership term that already carried one' and the policy says the second charge 'is refunded as a duplicate charge whatever the fee refund window'. Uniqueness: within_refund_window applies to a charge the member asks back inside the window; this charge is 373 days old and was never asked back, so only duplicate_charge fits.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.amount_usd: Value 23.90 = amount booked on the second charge 20.00 + courtesy credit 3.90. Courtesy method: DAYS(2025-09-16, 2026-09-24) = 373 >= 180 -> months x rate held to the limit. Courtesy months: whole months 12, 2 discounted fills in the last 12 whole months (2025-11-10, 2026-08-17; 2025-09-23 excluded at exactly 12 months) -> 13. Rate: 4 fee charges standing, none refunded -> 0.30. RND(13 x 0.30) = 3.90, limit for Kestrel Care Rewards Gold 4.00 -> 3.90. Refund RND(20.00 + 3.90) = 23.90.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.enrollment_id: Value dacbef97-0cf2-4e63-a3f3-0502708eb80b. Basis: the agent reads it out from the program-enrollment lookup; it is the only club membership and its current term (benefit_period_start 2026-09-15) has no fee charge. Uniqueness: the cancelled discount card carries no fee.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.amount_usd: Value 13.14. Loyalty: fee charges booked 4 less refunded 1 (the refund just made) = 3 -> 10 points. Rewards level Gold -> 5 points. Coverage: no plan in active status and the Commercial Copay Plan closed 2026-07-31, 1 whole month ago -> 10 points. Pickups dated fewer than 12 whole months before today = 8 -> 2 points. Total 27 points once on the 20.00 enrollment fee -> 14.60. Guarantee: club savings in the last 12 whole months 8.70 + 3.90 = 12.60 against the fee most recently charged 20.00 -> at least half but below the whole -> the reduced fee is multiplied by 0.90: RND(14.60 x 0.90) = 13.14, not below zero.

evaluation_criteria.necessity: First half of the unlock/call pair, no DB effect.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Book the club price on the rosuvastatin cash fill of 2026-09-23.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: copay_ext_club_cash_price computes patient_pay_after_usd; this is the price the member asked for.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.enrollment_id: Value dacbef97-0cf2-4e63-a3f3-0502708eb80b. argument_uniqueness_tracing.fill_id: Value 7de0f01e-3dc1-4285-8782-896f5cb5e387. Basis: the policy reads the price from 'the patient's latest cash fill, which is the fill being priced'; find_rx_fills shows one cash fill, the rosuvastatin rx_refill of 2026-09-23 with no pickup yet, and the customer asks for the price 'on that rosuvastatin'. Uniqueness: every other fill is billed to insurance or already carries a club-price entry.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.usual_price_usd: Value 96.40. Basis: the policy says 'The usual and customary price of the fill is the patient pay that the fill ledger shows on the patient's latest cash fill'; that fill shows patient_pay_usd 96.40. Uniqueness: a single value on a single fill.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.patient_pay_after_usd: Value 58.73. Rate: Kestrel Care Rewards Gold with 8 pickups in the last 12 whole months (>= 6) -> 30 percent. Member years: fee charges booked 5 (including the renewal just paid) less refunded 1 = 4 -> 4 points. Days supply 90 >= 84 -> 3 points. Total 37 percent once on 96.40 -> 60.732 -> 60.73. Refill: Kestrel Auto Refill 90-Day active -> 2.00 adherence credit -> 58.73. Minimum 3.00 and limit 96.40 do not bind; generic product, so the brand rule does not apply.

factor_trace: courtesy_credit_method (method): second charge = the later of the two 2025-09-15-term charges, copay_activity e7f80b77-6d53-43de-ba25-b326318be8d9 dated 2025-09-16, amount 20.00; DAYS(2025-09-16, 2026-09-24) = 373 >= 180 -> courtesy months x courtesy rate, rounded, held to the limit = MN(4.00, RND(13 x 0.30)) = 3.90; baseline (no courtesy credit) gives 20.00.

courtesy_month_count (parameter: a month adjustment of +1 / -1 / 0): whole months 2025-09-16 -> 2026-09-24 = 12; discounted fills dated fewer than 12 whole months before today = 2 (2025-11-10 amoxicillin-clavulanate and 2026-08-17 metformin; the 2025-09-23 lisinopril entry is exactly 12 months old and excluded) -> whole months plus one = 13; baseline (whole months, 12) gives 20.00 + MN(4.00, 3.60) = 23.60.

courtesy_rate_by_standing_charges (parameter): fee charges booked 4 (2023-09-15, 2024-09-15, 2025-09-15, 2025-09-16) less refunded 0 = 4 -> 0.30 a month; baseline 0.25 gives 20.00 + RND(13 x 0.25) = 23.25.

courtesy_limit_by_rewards_level (parameter, cross-difficulty rewards): rewards_memberships 9b470c14-9b0c-47d9-8417-440b2e20d251 Kestrel Care Rewards Gold, active -> limit 4.00 (3.90 is under it); baseline 3.00 gives 20.00 + 3.00 = 23.00.
second_charge_amount (read): 20.00 booked on the second charge; result = RND(20.00 + 3.90) = 23.90.

factor_sensitivity.tier_taken: exactly 3 fee charges standing (4 booked less 1 refunded)
no coverage record in active status AND the latest terminated coverage record closed fewer than 12 whole months before today (closed 2026-07-31, 1 whole month)
those savings are at least half of that fee but less than the whole of it (12.60 against 20.00): the reduced renewal fee is multiplied by 0.90

factor_trace: renewal_loyalty_points (parameter): at handling time (the second charge refunded) charges booked 4 less refunded 1 = 3 -> 10 points; baseline 0 gives 14.94.
renewal_rewards_level_points (parameter, cross-difficulty rewards): Kestrel Care Rewards Gold -> 5 points; baseline 0 gives 14.04.

renewal_pickup_points (parameter, cross-difficulty rx): rx_pickup entries dated fewer than 12 whole months before 2026-09-24 = 8 (2025-10-19, 2025-11-10, 2025-12-29, 2026-01-20, 2026-03-28, 2026-04-21, 2026-06-26, 2026-08-18; 2025-09-24 is 12 whole months old and excluded) -> 2 points; baseline 0 gives 13.50.

factor_sensitivity.tier_taken: Kestrel Care Rewards Gold member AND 6 or more prescription pickups dated fewer than 12 whole months before today (8)
exactly 4 membership fee charges standing (5 booked less 1 refunded)
the fill's days supply dispensed is 84 days or more (90)
an automated refill enrollment in active status under Kestrel Auto Refill 90-Day

member_years_points (parameter): at handling time charges booked 5 (the four seeded plus the 2026-09-15-term renewal fee just paid) less refunded 1 = 4 -> 4 points; baseline 0 gives 62.59.
days_supply_points (parameter, cross-difficulty rx): latest cash fill rx_fills 7de0f01e-3dc1-4285-8782-896f5cb5e387 days supply 90 >= 84 -> 3 points; baseline 0 gives 61.62.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The tree is a chain (price <- renewal fee <- duplicate refund); there are no parallel prerequisites. The order is pinned by the two prerequisite sentences: the renewal fee 'is not fixed until every second fee charge booked for one earlier membership term carries its refund', and the club price 'is fixed only after the membership fees account carries a fee charge for the membership term in which the fill date falls'. Reordering changes values: paying the renewal before the refund gives 12.24 (loyalty 15 points) instead of 13.14, and pricing before the renewal gives 62.59 instead of 58.73.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the renewal payment leaves standing charges at 3 when the price is worked out: patient_pay_after_usd 58.73 -> 62.59, and the terminal ledger lacks the 2026-09-15-term fee charge.
Skipping the duplicate refund leaves standing charges at 4 when the renewal fee is worked out: amount_usd 13.14 -> 12.24 (loyalty 15 points), and the terminal ledger lacks the 23.90 refund.
